opening.argument: The report centers on PM Modi’s meeting with state chief ministers and their discussion of the COVID-19 lockdown. It describes why the lockdown might continue and what circumstances could affect that decision, presenting uncertainty about government action as news rather than a promised outcome. The visible subscription prompt is ordinary audience engagement; it is not tied to a financial or data-related offer. Taken together, these are the elements of political reporting, not a solicitation directed at viewers.

citations.quote: PM Modi Remains Close Guarded On Lockdown Extension In Meeting With CMs | ABP News
